shellCommands.command: ls node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "node_modules present" || echo "no node_modules"; npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cat > /tmp/UserStats.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { expect, test } from 'vitest'
import UserStats from '/workspace/app/UserStats'

test('shows counts and percentage', () => {
  render(
    <UserStats
      users={[
        { id: 1, name: 'John', isActive: true },
        { id: 2, name: 'Jane', isActive: false },
        { id: 3, name: 'Bob', isActive: true },
      ]}
    />,
  )
  expect(screen.getByText('Active Users: 2')).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText('Inactive Users: 1')).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText('Active Percentage: 67%')).toBeTruthy()
})

test('handles empty list without NaN', () => {
  render(<UserStats users={[]} />)
  expect(screen.getByText('Active Users: 0')).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText('Inactive Users: 0')).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText('Active Percentage: 0%')).toBeTruthy()
})
EOF
cd /workspace && npx vitest run --root /tmp --environment jsdom --dir /tmp /tmp/UserStats.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -20

sed "s#'/workspace/app/UserStats'#'./UserStats'#" /tmp/UserStats.test.tsx > app/UserStats.tmp.test.tsx && npx vitest run --environment jsdom app/UserStats.tmp.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -12; rm -f app/UserStats.tmp.test.tsx; git status --short
